changes.message: Dedicated Relaxation Analysis module with several fitting models
New Chemical Shift Mapping Analysis module with new fitting models
New scientific packages to the environment (RDKit, EMCEE etc)
Auto and manual arrangement of peak labels
Tutorials: intro to NMR, Dynamics, CSM, BRMB/NMR-STAR, NEF-Pipelines
Threading issues caused by the IPython console history manager
Conda environment with the latest updates (Python 3.10, Numpy, Scipy, QT etc.)
Validate Paths: new features including Search & Replace

revisions.summary: A new release with plenty of new features! (Requires a fresh download)

changes.message: The update mechanism will now automatically iterate through all available updates. This is sometimes required, for example, to actually fix bugs in the updater itself
Spectrum-displays should now be a little quicker for Windows after a fix for CentOS8 slowed them down again.
For the macro-editor, and the python console: access to the core-classes is available by import ccpn.core

revisions.summary: There have been a few changes to the update mechanism.

changes.message: When dragging peaks with the right-mouse button, the line-widths and volumes will be set to None to indicate they are no longer valid for the maually moved peak.
More popup warnings have been added to protect against accidentally deleting core objects.
Added "Don't show this again" option to some popups. These can be re-enabled in preferences.
